content:
olivia (Finance Ops): FYI invoice INV-2026-0893 charge failed -> `INSTRUMENT_DECLINED` from acquirer. Customer claims card is active.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): saw that. customer name: Nuveta Labs. They use a virtual card from Ramp.
olivia (Finance Ops): right — stripe charge id `ch_3KqZ9a2eX` shows `card_type: virtual`. decline code: `instrument_declined`. No AVS mismatch.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): emailed customer asking them to try a physical card or add a new card. They replied: "card active, works elsewhere."
olivia (Finance Ops): tried soft-retry via Stripe dashboard at 11:02am — `POST /v1/charges/:id/attempts` -> still declined.
stripe-bot: Automated note: last 3 gateways returned `INSTRUMENT_DECLINED`, `card_not_supported`, `do_not_honor`. See logs: https://dashboard.stripe.com/payments/ch_3KqZ9a2eX/logs
customer-support: Customer is asking for immediate access; they're blocked on our integration test environment. Can we do a temporary workaround?
ben (Finance Lead): what's the invoice amount?
olivia (Finance Ops): $14,200. High risk to just force. Options: 1) request ACH/wire instructions; 2) ask for alternate card; 3) manual approval to retry and fallback to fallback-processor (higher fee).
ashwin (Acct Mgr): customer prefers to avoid wire. Offering a 48-hour hold on access if they supply a valid payment method.
olivia (Finance Ops): If they can provide bank details we can create ACH Debit (requires microdeposits) — won't help today. Wire will get them live today but we need PO & beneficiary details.
ben (Finance Lead): Approve manual retry only if we have signed MSA + PO. If they supply PO and wire instructions, finance will accept wire to expedite.
olivia (Finance Ops): copying support thread: "PO#: P-99012, contact: payroll@nuve.ta, they can provide wire details" — but customer says treasury on vacation until Tuesday.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): treasury autopay window closed today; they asked if we can provision test access for 72h while awaiting payment.
ben (Finance Lead): OK to grant 72h staging access on conditional terms: must submit PO today and commit to wire by next business day. No production tokens enabled. Document decision in CRM.
olivia (Finance Ops): I'll record conditional access note and create a manual invoice hold release. Also sending wire template and required fields: `beneficiary_name`, `iban` (or `acct_num` + `routing`), `bank_name`, `bank_address`, `swift`, `reference` (INV-2026-0893).
olivia (Finance Ops): sending customer the wire template now and cc'ing @ashwin. Also adding fallback charge plan if wire fails.
customer-support: flagged engineering to enable staging tokens for 72h, limited to dev endpoints.
ashwin (Acct Mgr): customer replied with PO attached but no wire details yet. Moving to follow up with treasury contact.
olivia (Finance Ops): note for records: exported attempted charges CSV and put in /finance/payments/failures/2239001234-export.csv. snippet: ```
charge_id,invoice,amount,decline_code
ch_3KqZ9a2eX,INV-2026-0893,14200,instrument_declined
```
ben (Finance Lead): good. once PO is in our system and they provide wire, finance to mark invoice as paid on receipt. If wire missing by EOD Tuesday, revoke staging access.
olivia (Finance Ops): will follow up Mon morning if no wire. tagging for visibility @ben. :white_check_mark:
